title: Design System: NOVA BUILDING & DESIGN LLC

display.purpose: Hero headline only; uppercase condensed, one phrase in gold.

body.purpose: All reading copy, sentence case, 30em max for ledes.

label.purpose: Button text, field labels and legends; 12px/.12em variant for plan annotations.

shadows.name: button-rest
shadows.purpose: Only on the filled gold button.

shadows.name: stone-lift
shadows.value: canvas fill rgba(6,18,38,.38-.4), offset 2-6px scaled by lift
shadows.purpose: Pavers mid-drop in the hero plan; fades as they settle.

motion.name: control-state
motion.purpose: Buttons, row arrows, Facebook bar; removed under reduced motion.

motion.name: stone-drop
motion.purpose: A paver dropping into the patio.

motion.name: self-lay
motion.purpose: Hero patio lays itself when untouched, then resets.

motion.name: lawn-sway
motion.value: spring K 38, damp 6.5, push radius 64px, max 11px; sway .16/.09 rad at speed 1.7
motion.purpose: Tufts sway and part under the pointer.

motion.name: lawn-seam
motion.value: two sines, 5px @1.2 and 3px @1.9 opposite directions, 56px strip
motion.purpose: Moving color seam between section sheets.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Hero drawn fully laid with fire lit; lawn strips painted once; no loop, no smooth scroll.

narrative.overview:
The whole site is a landscape site-plan sheet. Every surface is blueprint blue with white drafting linework, and the hero is a live plan drawing: a hatched house footprint, a door swing, a dashed patio outline, a fire-pit ring, stepping-stone outlines and a north arrow. The visitor drags a finger or mouse across it and pavers drop into the patio. "Building & Design" is something the visitor does on the page. Real stone colors show up only where something gets built. Everything else stays blue, white and line.

Density is phone-first and generous. Headlines are huge condensed caps, there is one promise line, and the actions are big tap targets. The page reads as a stack of sheets (blue, second blue, blue) separated by strips of drawn lawn whose tufts sway. A wavy color seam moves underneath them, so the lower sheet's color rises up under the grass. Lion gold is the trim color from the logo. Cyan is the drafting-pen color of interaction and only appears when something is hovered or focused.

The build rejects the contractor defaults it was made against: a stock patio photo as the hero, a gold-and-black banner, and grids of icon cards. Black grounds are out entirely. The darkest surface is still blue.
keyCharacteristics: Blueprint-blue sheets only, with a drafting grid and white linework. No black or neutral-gray grounds.
Condensed heavy uppercase for display, drawn from the system font stack to match the logo's "BUILDING & DESIGN".
Lion gold as trim and as the single filled action. Plan cyan only for hover and focus.
Signature motion: the visitor lays pavers in the hero, and lawn tufts sway with a moving seam between sections.
With reduced motion, the plan shows as a finished still drawing.

rules.name: The Blue Ground Rule
rules.body: Every surface is one of the three blueprint blues. No black, near-black or neutral-gray ground, including the footer and overscroll.

rules.name: The Built-Things-Only Rule
rules.body: Stone, sand, bluestone and fire colors appear only where something is constructed in a drawing. Interface chrome never borrows them.

rules.name: The Hover-Only Accent Rule
rules.body: Plan cyan, and the gold fill on row arrows and the Facebook link, appear only in response to hover or focus. At rest, gold is limited to trim and the single filled Text button.

rules.name: The System Stack Rule
rules.body: Display and body both come from the system font stack. The condensed heavy caps come from Avenir Next Condensed, Roboto Condensed or Arial Narrow. Don't load webfonts.

rules.name: The Caps Are Display Rule
rules.body: Uppercase condensed type is for headlines, row names, button text, field labels and plan annotations. Reading copy is always sentence case in the body face.

rules.name: The Phone Top-Right Rule
rules.body: On the first screen, the phone number appears only as the top-right header link. Email appears only in the footer. There is no sticky bottom bar or floating call button.

rules.name: The Flat Sheet Rule
rules.body: Cards, rows, photos and the form sit flat on the sheet, framed by hairlines. Depth means a deeper blue or a drawn object, never a floating panel.

dos: Do keep every ground on blueprint blue, second sheet or footer sheet, and switch between them only with a lawn strip.
Do set headlines, row names, buttons and field labels in the condensed heavy caps from the system stack (Avenir Next Condensed / Roboto Condensed / Arial Narrow) at weight 800.
Do keep lion gold to trim plus the one filled button per decision, with navy ink on any gold fill.
Do outline form controls in plan cyan on hover and focus, and use the 3px cyan focus ring everywhere else.
Do draw new illustration as plan symbols: dashed means planned, filled stone means built, white linework on the drafting grid.
Do give every animated drawing a finished still frame under reduced motion, and run animation only while it is on screen.
donts: Don't use black, near-black or neutral-gray grounds anywhere, including the footer.
Don't put the phone number anywhere on the first screen except the top-right header link. Don't show email outside the footer, and don't add a sticky bottom bar or floating call button.
Don't highlight a whole service row on hover. Only its arrow fills gold.
Don't show cyan, or gold fills on rows and links, at rest. The accent appears on hover and focus only.
Don't use a stock patio photo as the hero, a gold-and-black banner, or icon-card grids for services.
Don't load webfonts, and don't set reading copy in caps.
Don't use stone, sand or fire colors in interface chrome.
